verdict.rationale: The evidence documents relayed authorisation and transaction rules for live decisioning. Nothing shows a sandbox tool for simulating authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, or declines. The only testing item (forcing failed verification checks) concerns verification error handling, an adjacent feature that is not transaction-lifecycle simulation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can simulate the whole transaction lifecycle in the sandbox — authorizations, clearings, reversals, refunds, and declines — so my auth logic is tested before a real card ever swipes
